# Scholar Rock to Present at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference


## Main content section


## Scholar Rock to Present at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference


July 29, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.scholarrock.com/node/12176/pdf)


CAMBRIDGE, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 29, 2026-- Scholar Rock (NASDAQ: SRRK), a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to improving the lives of children and adults with spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and additional rare, severe, and debilitating neuromuscular diseases by applying its leading platform in myostatin biology, today announced that management will present at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston, MA on Wednesday, August 12, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. ET.


A live webcast of the event will be available under the “Events and Presentations” page within the Investors section of the Scholar Rock website at[http://investors.scholarrock.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.scholarrock.com&esheet=54577248&newsitemid=20260729231376&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.scholarrock.com&index=1&md5=c40b6d715b0cf6dea175d79aa7c63a33) . A replay of the webcast will be available for approximately 90 days.


**About Scholar Rock**


Scholar Rock is a late-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing apitegromab for children and adults with spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare, severe, and debilitating neuromuscular diseases. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more at[ScholarRock.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fscholarrock.com%2F&esheet=54577248&newsitemid=20260729231376&lan=en-US&anchor=ScholarRock.com&index=2&md5=3a4df5d22196baa6334120625c3f5bd8) and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.
